description: The central government's language-AI platform 'Bhashini' has been integrated with Kerala police' iCoPS system enabling officers to prepare reports and documents without having to type them out. The language AI has been merged with the Integrated Core Policing System (iCoPS) used by the Kerala police to carry out its daily operations and office work, a state police release said.
